topic: Native positive-length top Ext with arbitrary coefficients
scope: Positive length n+1; native Koszul-regular f over a commutative ring; arbitrary N and HasExt universe. The exact kernel of seqTopExtClass is I • N, and its induced actual coefficient quotient equivalence to Ext^(n+1)(R/I,N) is R/I-linear and natural in N.
source_relation: Adapts the actual free-presentation proof of ChainComplex.Koszul.topExtClass_ker and the subsequent equivalence/naturality definitions, replacing only the source class and ideal with the already proved canonical native counterparts.
upstream_audit: Stacks DualExactness.mem_span_iff_exists_dual_d_eq is ring-valued and already used in the previous native ring-kernel leaf. It does not provide the arbitrary-coefficient quotient equivalence. Mathlib provides actual free Finsupp presentation, ShortComplex.kernelSequence, Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₂, and Submodule quotient tools. These are reused directly. Colib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.Ext.Quotient provides Ext.quotientSourceIsTorsionBySet and Ext.quotientSourceModule; Mathlib provides the underlying IsTorsionBySet.module construction.
proof_structure: Project onto all coordinates to establish the free-module kernel from the ring kernel. Lift arbitrary coefficients to their actual free presentation, use native covariant Ext exactness and top-class surjectivity on the kernel module, then descend ideal membership.
limits: Positive length only; empty sequence remains a separate degree-zero normalization task.
No flatness, regularity, finiteness, Noetherianity, or nontriviality required for coefficients.
No old named Aglib class comparison asserted.
No old environment/cache recovery, kernel replay, or shared-file modifications.
